LanguageData.RR_EvidenceCreation_UnsupportedSchema: This save has an unsupported evidence-creation format. Preserve the original save and use its matching build.
LanguageData.RR_EvidenceCreation_InvalidSave: The evidence creation journal or custody is inconsistent. The original objects are retained; preserve the save and inspect the game log before continuing.
LanguageData.RR_EvidenceCreation_Busy: The original evidence object is already being processed.
LanguageData.RR_EvidenceCreation_RetainedLimit: Eight unfinished evidence acquisitions are retained. Resolve their original-object recovery before creating more.
LanguageData.RR_EvidenceCreation_CustodyChanged: The original document's location or ownership changed. Restore its recorded custody before retrying; a replacement will not be generated.
LanguageData.RR_EvidenceCreation_CreationInterrupted: Evidence creation was interrupted. Retry can place or register the same retained original only. Preserve the save and inspect the game log if its creation did not return an object.
LanguageData.RR_EvidenceCreation_InitializationInterr: Native book initialization began but did not finish. The original is retained. Preserve this save and inspect the game log; retry will not reroll its contents.
LanguageData.RR_EvidenceCreation_OriginalMissing: The original evidence document is missing or destroyed. It will not be replaced by revisiting or retrying.
LanguageData.RR_EvidenceRecovery_Explanation: Recover the original physical document after interrupted placement or registration. Retry preserves its identity and contents; it does not generate a duplicate.
